excerpt: A Complete Checklist for Newcomers to Canada: From Airport to Settlement Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. If you are living in Canada on a temporary permit such as a work or study permit, you might wonder what happens if your permit expires while your renewal application is still being processed. Fortunately, Canada’s immigration system has an important protection called Maintained Status that allows you to stay legally in Canada during this period.
